businesses.name: 360 Surveying
businesses.tagline: East Texas land surveying for residential and commercial property
businesses.write_up: 360 Surveying is a Longview-based land surveying firm serving Gregg County and a wide swath of East Texas, with coverage extending to more than 20 counties including Smith, Upshur, Harrison, Rusk, and the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Services include boundary surveys for residential and commercial property, title surveys, mortgage surveys, topographic surveys, as-built surveys, oil and gas surveying, subdivision platting, construction staking, and UAV drone photography and mapping. The team brings a combined 66 years of surveying experience and works with realtors, builders, landowners, and energy companies. The office is at 310 H G Mosley Pkwy in Longview.

businesses.name: 66 Property Management
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial property management in Longview
businesses.write_up: 66 Property Management handles residential and commercial rental management in Longview, including tenant screening, lease preparation, rent collection and maintenance coordination. The office maintains current residential and commercial rental listings. Marshall Jackson is the broker of record for the firm.

businesses.name: 903 Inspections, LLC
businesses.tagline: Buyer and seller home inspections in Longview
businesses.write_up: 903 Inspections is a Longview-based home inspection company run by Daniel Larsen, a Texas Professional Home Inspector (TREC Lic. #25554). The company performs pre-purchase buyer inspections and pre-listing seller inspections, described as an objective visual inspection of the home structure and systems. Its stated service area includes Longview, Kilgore, Gladewater, Lakeport, Marshall, Gilmer, Diana, Hawkins, Jefferson, Tatum, and Henderson.

businesses.name: A/C Contractors
businesses.tagline: HVAC and plumbing serving Gregg County since 1982
businesses.write_up: A/C Contractors has served Gregg, Smith, Harrison, and Rusk counties since 1982 from its Longview headquarters at 3830 Gilmer Road. The company provides residential and commercial air conditioning, heating, plumbing, indoor air quality, and generator services, backed by its Fixed Right or It's Free guarantee and upfront pricing. Licensed technicians offer same-day scheduling and 24/7 emergency service with no after-hours fees. The company operates under Texas HVAC license TACLB 142226E and also has a Tyler location.

businesses.name: Absolute Realty Marketing
businesses.tagline: Real estate photography, drone imaging, and 3D tours
businesses.write_up: Absolute Realty Marketing, a service of Longview-based Absolute Technology Solutions, provides professional real estate photography, aerial drone photos and video, and immersive 3D tours for agents and brokers. Interior shoots include a complimentary 2D floor plan, and the company offers fast turnaround on standard listing photos plus online marketing and MLS listing pages. It is affiliated with the Longview Area Association of Realtors, the East Texas Builders Association, and the Texas Association of Builders. The office is at 418 Lake Lamond Rd in Longview, with a second Absolute location in Nacogdoches.

businesses.name: ACH Construction
businesses.tagline: Custom homes, barndominiums and commercial builds
businesses.write_up: ACH Construction builds custom homes, barndominiums, commercial buildings and investment properties for clients in Longview and the surrounding East Texas region. The company was founded by James Arledge and also maintains locations in Mt. Pleasant, Tyler and Rockwall. Services include new construction, remodeling and general contracting.

businesses.name: Acme Air Conditioning & Heating
businesses.tagline: Longview HVAC repair, maintenance, and installation (now Summit Air Conditioning & Heating)
businesses.write_up: Acme Air Conditioning & Heating has served Longview, Tyler, and surrounding East Texas communities for nearly two decades from its shop on McCann Road in Longview. The team handles AC and heater repair, replacement, and maintenance, plus ductless systems, duct cleaning, smart thermostats, indoor air quality, new-construction work, and commercial HVAC. Service areas include Hallsville, White Oak, Lake Cherokee, Diana, and Beckville, and the company holds Texas license TACLB70972E. Acme recently announced that the same team now operates under the name Summit Air Conditioning & Heating.

businesses.name: Adams, King, & Smith
businesses.tagline: Longview practice focused on wills, trusts, and probate
businesses.write_up: Adams, King, & Smith is a Longview law firm at 424 N. Center Street whose site describes wills, estate planning, and probate as its only business. Work listed includes revocable, irrevocable, and testamentary trusts, powers of attorney, directives to physicians, healthcare directives, and beneficiary designations. The firm states attorney Kris King has more than 40 years of experience in these areas and offers virtual, phone, and in-person consultations.

businesses.name: Added Space Self Storage
businesses.tagline: Locally owned climate-controlled storage in Longview
businesses.write_up: Added Space Self Storage is a locally owned and operated storage facility at 6548 McCann Rd in north Longview, also serving Hallsville, Gilmer, Gladewater, and Kilgore. The gated property offers climate-controlled units, drive-up access, RV and vehicle parking with electric hookups on covered spots, security cameras, and an on-site resident manager. Renters get free use of dollies and carts, and there are no deposits or move-in fees. The facility is also an authorized U-Haul dealership, which is handy when a move and storage need to happen on the same day.

businesses.name: Advantage Building Services
businesses.tagline: Post-construction and janitorial cleaning since 1996
businesses.write_up: Advantage Building Services is a Longview commercial cleaning company at 1502 E Whaley St, established in 1996. The company handles pre- and post-construction cleaning across East Texas along with janitorial service for office and multi-tenant buildings. Floor care services include carpet cleaning, tile and grout cleaning, and floor polishing and buffing.

businesses.name: Advantage Home Inspections
businesses.tagline: Kilgore-based inspector serving Longview and Gregg County
businesses.write_up: Advantage Home Inspections is a home inspection company based at 1074 Harvey Rd in Kilgore, with Longview listed in its service area. The company offers home inspection services with online scheduling and a sample report available. Additional listed service areas include Tyler, Hallsville, Marshall, Gladewater, White Oak, Gilmer, Henderson, and New Diana.

businesses.name: Alco Air
businesses.tagline: HVAC, plumbing, and generators in Longview
businesses.write_up: Alco Air has served the Longview area for more than 30 years from its location on US-259, handling air conditioning, heating, plumbing, indoor air quality, and whole-home generator work for homes and businesses. Technicians are NATE certified, and the company belongs to the BBB, the PHCC, and the Texas chapter of ACCA. Its customer service line takes emergency calls around the clock, and a VIP Club maintenance membership covers twice-yearly tune-ups with priority scheduling. Texas licenses: TACLA23812C and M-41085.

businesses.name: All-N-One Moving
businesses.tagline: Licensed local and long-distance movers based in the Longview area
businesses.write_up: All-N-One Moving is a family-run, licensed and insured moving company (TX DMV #10187767C) based in the Longview area, serving Longview, Tyler, Marshall, Kilgore, Gilmer, Carthage, and the rest of East Texas. Services cover local, long-distance, and commercial moves along with packing, senior moving, storage solutions, and labor-only loading and unloading. The company gives flat, binding written quotes, and on long-distance jobs the same crew that loads the truck drives it to the destination. Crews work seven days a week, 8 AM to 6 PM.

businesses.name: Area Wide Appraisal Service
businesses.tagline: Residential real estate appraisals serving Longview
businesses.write_up: Area Wide Appraisal Service is a residential real estate appraisal firm located on South Mobberly Avenue in Longview. The company performs home appraisals and residential property valuations for the Longview area, serving lenders, homeowners, and other real estate professionals. Its office sits in Longview's 75602 zip code on the south side of town.

businesses.name: Austin Bank
businesses.tagline: East Texas community bank offering home loans in Longview
businesses.write_up: Austin Bank is an East Texas community bank serving personal and business customers, with a Longview office on East Loop 281 that opened in February 1996. The Loop location offers checking and savings accounts, consumer and business lending, mortgages, safe deposit boxes, notary service, and a drive-thru with extended hours, including Saturday mornings. Home loans sit alongside auto, business, agricultural, and aircraft lending in the bank's wider lineup. Austin Bank is a Member FDIC and Equal Housing Lender.

businesses.name: Beer Wells Real Estate Services - East Texas, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Commercial real estate in downtown Longview since 1994
businesses.write_up: Beer Wells Real Estate Services - East Texas, Inc. was established in April 1994 and has grown into a well-established commercial real estate firm in Longview. From its office on North Center Street downtown, the team handles sales and leasing of office, retail, and other commercial properties. The firm is a longtime fixture in the Longview commercial market and serves clients throughout Gregg County and East Texas.

businesses.name: Ben Maines Air Conditioning
businesses.tagline: Heating and cooling in Longview since 1949
businesses.write_up: Ben Maines Air Conditioning was founded in Longview in 1949 and has been in the heating and cooling business ever since. Operating from 205 Enterprise St, the company is a Lennox Premier Dealer offering AC repair, installation, and maintenance, furnace and heat pump service, duct cleaning, indoor air quality work, and commercial refrigeration, with 24/7 emergency support. It is also a Generac certified warranty dealer and serves Longview plus a wide ring of East Texas communities from Kilgore to Marshall. The company operates under Texas license TACLA6042C.

businesses.name: Blackaller Engineering & Surveying
businesses.tagline: Longview engineering and surveying firm serving East Texas
businesses.write_up: Blackaller Engineering & Surveying was founded in 1985 by Gary Blackaller, a Professional Engineer (Texas PE No. 54222) and Registered Professional Land Surveyor (RPLS No. 4445). The firm provides civil engineering and land surveying services to Longview and roughly eleven surrounding East Texas counties. Gary is a Texas A&M civil engineering graduate and U.S. Navy Seabees veteran who earned his PE registration in 1983 while at the Texas Department of Transportation. The office is at 2810 Bill Owens Parkway, Suite 200, in Longview.

businesses.name: Blue Sky Group Realty
businesses.tagline: Local Longview Realtors helping you buy and sell with confidence
businesses.write_up: Blue Sky Group Realty is a locally owned real estate firm on Judson Road in Longview. It was founded by Lindsey Farnham, a native East Texan and Realtor who has worked in the industry since 2010. The team helps buyers and sellers with homes throughout Longview and the surrounding Gregg County area, including families relocating to town. The firm operates under Texas broker license #9009598.

businesses.name: Bockmon, Knight & Traylor Insurance Agency
businesses.tagline: Independent East Texas insurance agency on Loop 281
businesses.write_up: Bockmon, Knight & Traylor is the Longview office of the Bockmon Insurance Agency family, which has been serving East Texas since 1974 with locations across the region. As an independent agency, the team shops multiple carriers, including Germania, Progressive, Liberty Mutual, Nationwide, and Travelers, to match clients with home, auto, life, health, and business coverage. The office sits at 450 E Loop 281 in Longview and is open weekdays from 8 to 5. For homebuyers, an independent agent can compare homeowners quotes from several companies in one stop.

businesses.name: Bold Real Estate Group
businesses.tagline: From Bold to Sold in Longview and East Texas
businesses.write_up: Bold Real Estate Group is a locally owned and operated brokerage on Judson Road in Longview. The team guides clients through buying, selling, and investing in single-family homes, land, and commercial property across Longview and the surrounding communities. The office runs largely paperless, offering e-notary services and digital signature tools to streamline transactions. The firm operates under Texas broker license #9003751.

businesses.name: Boon Calk Echols Coleman & Goolsby PLLC
businesses.tagline: Longview law firm handling real estate transactions, title conflicts and disputes
businesses.write_up: Boon Calk Echols Coleman & Goolsby PLLC is a full-service Longview law firm with roughly ten attorneys whose real estate practice covers transactions, contracts, property deeds, short sales, loan modifications, foreclosure defense, and real estate disputes. Its lawyers also handle estate planning, probate, business law, and personal injury matters, and the firm serves clients throughout East and Northeast Texas, including Longview, Gilmer, Henderson, Marshall, and Tyler. Attorneys can prepare and review purchase documents, resolve title and boundary conflicts, and litigate when a dispute cannot be settled. The office is at 1800 NW Loop 281, Suite 303, in Longview.

businesses.name: Bort Custom Homes
businesses.tagline: Family-run design-build custom homes in Longview
businesses.write_up: Bort Custom Homes is a family-operated design-build company in Longview led by owner and senior designer Gary Bort, who brings more than 30 years of custom residential design and construction experience. The firm keeps design, drafting, 3D visualization, and construction under one roof, so clients can see and price a project before building starts. Sons Michael and Matthew Bort help run project management and the design and 3D rendering process. Services cover custom homes, home remodeling, and commercial remodeling across Longview and East Texas, with the office at 174 Beechwood Dr Suite 104.

businesses.name: Bull & Barrett, PLLC
businesses.tagline: Longview firm handling real estate transactions and disputes
businesses.write_up: Bull & Barrett is a Longview law firm that advises clients on real estate transactions and litigation, representing buyers and sellers in purchases and sales. The practice includes property deeds, title history research, review of lending and mortgage documents, and disputes over contracts, boundaries, quiet title and land use. The office is in the Energy Center on Judson Road.

businesses.name: Byte Electric
businesses.tagline: Certified electricians for homes and businesses in Longview
businesses.write_up: Byte Electric is a Longview-based electrical contractor serving residential, commercial, and industrial customers across East Texas. The team is led by a master electrician with over 22 years of experience, and its licensed, background-checked electricians handle everything from new home wiring and panel upgrades to emergency repairs. While much of its work is commercial and industrial, the company also builds and upgrades electrical systems for homes throughout Longview, Tyler, Marshall, and surrounding communities.

businesses.name: C. Woods Company
businesses.tagline: Plumbing, HVAC and electrical with a Longview office
businesses.write_up: C. Woods Company operates a Longview office providing plumbing repair, drain and sewer cleaning, water heater work and 24-hour emergency service, alongside HVAC and electrical services. The company has been in operation since 1956 and is headquartered in Tyler. Texas licenses listed include plumbing M-37588, HVAC TACLB00109924E and electrical TECL 39413.

businesses.name: Central Title Company
businesses.tagline: Title and escrow across five East Texas counties
businesses.write_up: Central Title traces its roots to Central Abstract & Title Company, formed in Longview in 1931 by Paul B. Scott, Jas A. Hankerson, and E.P. Harding. Today it owns and operates the only sovereign title plants in Gregg, Smith, Harrison, Upshur, and Rusk counties, and runs six offices across East Texas: Longview, Tyler, Marshall, Gilmer, Hallsville, and a Kilgore fee office. The company handles title insurance and escrow closings for residential, commercial, construction, and refinance transactions. The Longview office is at 2002 Judson Rd, Suite 300.

businesses.name: Charles Tomberlain Insurance Agency
businesses.tagline: Homeowners and personal insurance on Judson Road
businesses.write_up: Charles Tomberlain Insurance Agency is an independent agency on Judson Road in Longview that writes personal and business coverage across Texas. Personal lines include auto, home, motorcycle, boat and watercraft, flood, and life insurance, while commercial offerings cover business owners packages, general liability, commercial auto, commercial real estate, and contractors insurance. As an independent agency, the team shops multiple carriers — including Safeco, Travelers, Progressive, Mercury, Kemper, and Foremost — to match coverage to each client. Free quotes are available by phone or through the agency's online forms.

businesses.name: Chelsea's Cleaning Services
businesses.tagline: The cleaning company that prays over every home
businesses.write_up: Chelsea's Cleaning Services is a Longview-based cleaning company offering house cleaning, move-in and move-out cleaning, Airbnb turnovers, and commercial cleaning. Its move-out service is built to help renters and sellers leave a spotless home behind, covering kitchens, bathrooms, carpets, and the details landlords check. Known by its motto as the cleaning company that prays over every home, the team serves homes and businesses across the Longview area six days a week.

businesses.name: Chris Hall Custom Homes LLC
businesses.tagline: Longview custom home and metal building contractor
businesses.write_up: Chris Hall Custom Homes is a Longview-based builder with more than 20 years of experience in new residential construction. Owner Chris Hall builds custom homes across East Texas and also consults on bath and kitchen remodels. The company works with a custom pool designer and builder so clients can add a pool to their new home build, and offers a range of cabinetry options from stain grade to faux finish. Chris Hall Custom Homes is an East Texas Builders Association member and entered the 2023 Fall Parade of Homes.

businesses.name: Coldwell Banker Lenhart Properties, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Family-owned East Texas brokerage headquartered in Longview
businesses.write_up: Coldwell Banker Lenhart Properties is a family-owned East Texas brokerage that Malinda Lenhart started in 1984 with just two agents. Headquartered at 1100 Judson Rd in Longview, the company now operates offices in Longview, Gilmer, Marshall, and Kilgore, with Jack Lenhart serving as managing broker for the residential and commercial divisions. The firm belongs to three Multiple Listing Services — the Longview Area Association of Realtors, Greater Tyler Association of Realtors, and Dallas MetroTex Association of Realtors — giving listings broad regional exposure. Agents handle residential, commercial, land, and investment transactions across Northeast Texas.

businesses.name: Collins Surveying & Mapping, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Full-service land surveying firm on Judson Road
businesses.write_up: Collins Surveying & Mapping, Inc. has been surveying and mapping in Greater East Texas since 1978, serving the Ark-La-Tex from regional offices in Longview and Atlanta, Texas, with licenses extending into Louisiana and Arkansas. The firm handles boundary and topographic surveys, construction staking, oil and gas surveying, and commercial, industrial, and residential work, and uses UAV drone technology to gather data quickly while maintaining accuracy. Clients range from energy companies and contractors to engineers and individual landowners. Collins operates under Texas firm number 10023000, and its Longview office is at 910 Judson Rd.

businesses.name: Craig Jackson Insurance Agency
businesses.tagline: Authorized independent Mercury Insurance agency in Longview
businesses.write_up: Craig Jackson Insurance Agency is an authorized, independent Mercury Insurance agency located at 2002 Judson Rd in Longview. The office offers car, home, condo, renters, and business auto insurance, and the team helps clients look for every available discount on Texas coverage. The agency holds Texas insurance license 2667457 and is open weekdays from 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM. It is a convenient local stop for homebuyers who need a homeowners policy lined up before closing.

businesses.name: Crossland All In One Storage
businesses.tagline: Climate-controlled and RV storage on SE Loop 281
businesses.write_up: Crossland All In One Storage is a storage facility at 5876 SE Loop 281 in Longview, about a quarter mile north of I-20. Units range from roughly 50 to 630 square feet and include climate-controlled options, along with enclosed and covered RV and boat storage. The facility offers 24-hour gate access, drive-up access, and online payment, and states it serves the Longview and Hallsville area.

businesses.name: Darrell G. Dotson, Attorney at Law
businesses.tagline: Longview attorney practicing real estate, business and bankruptcy law
businesses.write_up: Darrell Glyn Dotson is a Longview attorney whose practice areas include real estate, bankruptcy, business, and employment law. He earned his law degree from the University of Houston Law Center and has been in practice for roughly three decades. His office is on Alexis Drive in Longview.

businesses.name: Decker Properties
businesses.tagline: Locally owned property management across East Texas
businesses.write_up: Decker Properties is a locally owned property management company based on South Fredonia Street in Longview, managing more than 150 rental units across five East Texas markets: Longview, Kilgore, Hallsville, Gilmer, and Gladewater. Founder Billy Decker is a licensed Realtor and active real estate investor. Services for owners include tenant screening, leasing and marketing, rent collection with owner distributions, maintenance coordination, monthly statements, and eviction management in Gregg County courts. Tenants get an online portal for rent payments, applications, and maintenance requests, and the company also handles real estate sales for investors.

businesses.name: Dixie Dunavant Insurance
businesses.tagline: Independent home and auto insurance agency in Longview
businesses.write_up: Dixie Dunavant Insurance is an independent agency on W Hawkins Parkway in Longview that has served East Texas since 1983. The agency compares home, auto, renters, umbrella, boat, classic car, RV, life, and commercial coverage across a broad carrier lineup that includes Safeco, Travelers, Progressive, Germania, GEICO, National General, and the Texas FAIR Plan. An online comparative quoting tool lets Texas residents review auto and home options before talking with a licensed agent. The team focuses on coverage that reflects local risks, from Gregg County commutes to East Texas weather exposure.

businesses.name: DJ Johnson Design Build
businesses.tagline: Longview design-build firm for custom and spec homes
businesses.write_up: DJ Johnson Design Build, operating as DJ Johnson Co. Inc., was established in Longview in 2001 and offers in-house design paired with construction. The firm builds custom residential homes and speculative homes, handles remodels, and takes on light commercial projects. Three-dimensional design services are offered, and design-only engagements are available.

businesses.name: Dust to Dazzle Maids
businesses.tagline: Move-in and move-out cleaning for Longview homes and rentals
businesses.write_up: Dust to Dazzle Maids provides recurring house cleaning, top-to-bottom deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and office cleaning in Longview and surrounding East Texas communities. Founder Carla Holmes started cleaning homes in 1982, and in 2017 the company rebranded its residential division as Dust to Dazzle Maids, with DNC Facility Services as its commercial sister company. Staff are background-checked, bonded, and insured, and the company backs its work with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Dust to Dazzle is also a partner of the Cleaning for a Reason charity, which provides free cleaning to cancer patients.

businesses.name: Dynamic Electricians
businesses.tagline: Locally owned electrical contractor serving Longview
businesses.write_up: Dynamic Electricians handles residential and commercial electrical work in Longview, including panel and service upgrades, rewiring, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, generators and new-construction wiring. The company states it has served the area since 1992 with certified journeyman electricians. It also serves Gladewater and Kilgore.

businesses.name: Earnest Jackson Electric Inc.
businesses.tagline: Longview electricians since 1969
businesses.write_up: Earnest Jackson Electric Inc. is one of Longview's longest-running electrical contractors, in business since April 1969. Located at 413 W Cotton in downtown Longview, the corporation is currently owned by John Reneau and holds an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau serving Central East Texas. More than five decades of continuous local operation is a rare thing in the trades, and it gives homeowners a familiar name to call for electrical work.

businesses.name: East Texas Foundation Repair
businesses.tagline: Foundation repair and house leveling on Judson Road
businesses.write_up: East Texas Foundation Repair operates from 5440 Judson Road in Longview, providing foundation repair, house leveling, pier and beam leveling, and mobile home leveling. The company also handles slab and concrete repair, drainage solutions, and water damage repair for properties across East Texas. Listed office hours are Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

businesses.name: East Texas Homes, LLC
businesses.tagline: New home construction and move-in-ready homes in Longview
businesses.write_up: East Texas Homes specializes in ground-up residential construction, managing the building process in-house from planning to completion, and offers both custom builds and move-in-ready spec homes in planned communities. Based on Judson Road in Longview, the company builds in Longview, White Oak, Hallsville, Marshall, Gladewater, Kilgore, Tyler, and surrounding towns. Beyond new construction, it offers home remodeling, custom pools, roofing, and financing options through local lending partners. East Texas Homes is a member of the East Texas Builders Association and works with the AEP/Swepco new home program for energy-efficient construction.

businesses.name: East Texas Preferred Properties - Longview
businesses.tagline: Residential, commercial, and rural land specialists
businesses.write_up: East Texas Preferred Properties is a Kilgore-based agency with dedicated agents serving the Longview market for home, commercial, and land transactions. As East Texas natives, ETXPP agents specialize in recreational, undeveloped, and rural acreage alongside residential listings and commercial property, and they market sellers' properties aggressively while helping buyers find the right fit. The firm maintains a dedicated Longview service area with agents assigned to the community.

businesses.name: East Texas Slab Masters
businesses.tagline: Foundation repair and house leveling for over 20 years
businesses.write_up: East Texas Slab Masters has served Longview and East Texas for more than 20 years, providing foundation repair, concrete slab repair, pier and beam work, and house leveling. Repair methods include pressed and drilled bell-bottom piers, polyurethane foam injection, retaining walls, and moisture containment barriers. The company holds an A+ BBB rating and offers free estimates, with a Longview service area covering Gladewater, White Oak, Kilgore, Lakeport, and the rest of Gregg County. It also maintains location pages for Tyler, Lufkin, Nacogdoches, and other East Texas cities.

businesses.name: East Texas Title Companies of Gregg County
businesses.tagline: Locally owned East Texas title group
businesses.write_up: East Texas Title Companies is a Texas-owned and operated group of title companies licensed in more than 87 counties, with its Gregg County office at 1516 Judson Rd in Longview. The office handles title insurance, title searches, and residential and commercial real estate closings, and offers fully online closings through Remote Online Notarization (RON) as well as traditional in-person signings. Attorneys from the affiliated Flowers Davis law firm review every file before closing and can assist with common title issues like liens, judgments, and estates. The group's administrative office is in Tyler, with additional branches across East Texas.

businesses.name: Eastcreek Appraisal Company, LLC
businesses.tagline: Residential real estate appraisals in East Texas
businesses.write_up: Eastcreek Appraisal Company is a Longview-based firm specializing in residential real estate appraisals for the greater East Texas area. Its work covers primary and secondary mortgages, refinances, relocation, estate and divorce settlements, land sales, and owner valuations.

businesses.name: Erick Dodge Insurance Agency Inc
businesses.tagline: Independent agency for home, auto, and business insurance
businesses.write_up: Erick Dodge Insurance Agency is an independent insurance agency located at 501 N Spur 63 in Longview. As a Travelers-appointed independent agent, the office helps clients compare coverage for home, car, renters, condo, landlord, and umbrella policies, along with specialty lines like boat and valuable-items coverage. Working with an independent agent means homebuyers get a local advocate who can walk through coverage options for a new house before closing day. The agency serves Longview and the surrounding East Texas area.

businesses.name: Fairway Independent Mortgage - Longview Branch
businesses.tagline: National lender with a Technology Circle branch in Longview
businesses.write_up: Fairway Independent Mortgage Corporation operates a Longview branch on Technology Circle staffed by licensed loan officers handling purchase, construction and refinance loans. Fairway is a national lender, NMLS entity ID #2289, and an Equal Housing Opportunity lender. Programs and eligibility are determined by the lender and subject to credit approval and underwriting.

businesses.name: G.E.T. Moving & Storage
businesses.tagline: Longview movers with climate-controlled storage
businesses.write_up: G.E.T. Moving & Storage is a family-run moving company that has served East Texas from Longview since 2013, completing more than 3,000 moves in its first nine years. Beyond local and nationwide household and commercial moves, the company sells packing supplies, offers full packing services, and operates a 45,000-square-foot climate-controlled storage facility on Hollybrook Drive with 205 units, added in 2015. The company is federally and state licensed (USDOT 2376411, TxDMV 006706712C) and is listed in the Longview Chamber of Commerce directory.

businesses.name: Gans & Smith Insurance Agency, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Longview independent agency for home, auto, and business insurance
businesses.write_up: Gans & Smith Insurance Agency is an independent agency on Judson Road in Longview that traces its roots to 1889, when it was organized by J.R. and T.E. Clemmons; it has carried its present name since 1912. The agency writes auto, home, health, life, and business insurance, plus group benefits and Medicare products, working with dozens of carriers to fit coverage to each client's needs and budget. It serves Longview and communities across East Texas — including Kilgore, Gilmer, Marshall, Gladewater, and Tyler — and is licensed in Texas and a dozen other states. Agents explain coverage in plain language and review existing policies for better options.

businesses.name: Gill Electric, LLC
businesses.tagline: Master electrician for Longview homes and businesses
businesses.write_up: Gill Electric is a licensed and insured electrical contractor on West Loop 281 in Longview, open 24/7 for scheduled work and emergency repairs. The company is owned by master electrician Cody Gill and holds Texas electrical contractor license TECL 25-365. Services for homes and businesses include electric panel installation and repair, electrical service upgrades, home wiring, generator installation and repair, exterior lighting, thermal imaging, and solar panel repair. Gill Electric serves Longview and the surrounding East Texas area.

businesses.name: Glade Investments, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial property managers since 2001
businesses.write_up: Glade Investments, Inc. is a licensed real estate brokerage and property management firm that has served East Texas since 2001. The company manages residential rentals and commercial office space for owners and tenants across Longview, Kilgore, White Oak, Hallsville, Gladewater, Gilmer, Big Sandy, Ore City, Overton, Troup, Henderson, Sabine, and Tyler. Tenants and owners use AppFolio online portals for rent payments, maintenance requests, and monthly statements. As active real estate investors themselves, the principals also act as buyer's agents for investment properties throughout the region.

businesses.name: Goforth Custom Builders, LLC
businesses.tagline: Custom homes and whole-home remodels serving Longview
businesses.write_up: Goforth Custom Builders is a family-owned custom home builder based at 108 W Main St in Hallsville, with Longview listed among its service areas. Owners Tommy and Allison Goforth build new custom homes, acreage and rural homes including builds on land the customer already owns, and handle major whole-home renovations. Floor plan design assistance is offered, and the office is open by appointment.

businesses.name: Goode Brothers Heating & Air Conditioning, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Family-owned HVAC serving Longview since 2000
businesses.write_up: Goode Brothers Heating & Air Conditioning is a family-owned HVAC company that has served Longview and East Texas since 2000 from its location on US-259. The licensed and insured team specializes in HVAC system replacements and installations using Lennox and Ruud equipment, and also handles repairs, maintenance, air duct work, zone control, and indoor air quality for homes and businesses. Same-day and 24/7 emergency service are offered when available, along with free equipment estimates, financing, and a Comfort Club maintenance membership. The service area stretches from Kilgore and White Oak to Gilmer, Hallsville, Henderson, and Jefferson. Texas license TACLB020580C.

businesses.name: Gordy Roofing Company
businesses.tagline: Roof repair and replacement in Longview since 1968
businesses.write_up: Gordy Roofing has served Longview and Gregg County since 1968, handling roof repair, full replacement, metal roofing, commercial roofing, and storm damage restoration for homes and businesses. The company is TDLR licensed and GAF Master Elite certified, offers free roof inspections, and provides 24/7 emergency response after storms, including help with insurance claims. Crews cover Longview neighborhoods from Spring Hill to Pine Tree plus nearby Kilgore, Hallsville, White Oak, Gladewater, and Marshall. Gordy is a member of the Longview Chamber of Commerce, East Texas Builders Association, and Tyler Area Builders Association, and is headquartered at 712 Glencrest Ln, Suite C2.

businesses.name: Greenlight Mortgage
businesses.tagline: Longview mortgage broker powered by Co/LAB Lending
businesses.write_up: Greenlight Mortgage, LLC is a licensed Texas mortgage broker (NMLS #2426021) based on Judson Road in Longview, led by president and CEO Kenneth Travis (NMLS #233918). As a broker rather than a bank, the team shops a network of lenders on a borrower's behalf and presents the options side by side, handling purchase, refinance, conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and jumbo loans for Longview and East Texas. All loans are subject to credit approval and underwriting, and program availability depends on each borrower's full application. Greenlight is powered by Co/LAB Lending. Equal Housing Opportunity.

businesses.name: Gregg County Title
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial title services in Longview
businesses.write_up: Gregg County Title now operates as part of 1st Choice Title Company, a Texas-owned title company headquartered in Gilmer; the former Gregg County Title website directs customers to the 1st Choice Title site. The Longview office at 1105 Judson Rd keeps the same local phone number and handles title insurance, title searches, and residential and commercial real estate closings. 1st Choice Title's team draws on an area network of professionals with more than 100 years of combined experience in the East Texas title business, with additional offices in Gilmer, Henderson, and Carthage. The office is open weekdays from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

businesses.name: Ground Crew Landscape
businesses.tagline: Longview lawn care and landscape design since 2007
businesses.write_up: Ground Crew Landscape is a Longview lawn care and landscaping company that has been in business since 2007. Owned by Eric Jacobson and based at 1307 Mockingbird Ln, the company works in lawn care, landscape contracting, and landscape design. It holds an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau serving Central East Texas. A well-kept landscape is one of the simpler ways to protect a home's value, and a local crew with a long track record makes it easier.

businesses.name: Guild Mortgage - Longview Branch
businesses.tagline: National independent lender with a local Longview branch
businesses.write_up: Guild Mortgage Company, an independent lender founded in 1960, operates a Longview branch on Hollybrook Drive led by branch manager Thomas Holyfield (NMLS #210861). The local team includes loan officers Dillon Swain, Harold Henderson, Charity Ellis, Jordan Johnson, Paula Lopez, and Whitney Parks. The branch offers conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, renovation, and down payment assistance programs, with local processing, underwriting, and funding. Branch NMLS #1382903; licensed in Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Oklahoma. All loans are subject to underwriting approval.

businesses.name: Hamilton Group
businesses.tagline: Third-generation Longview design-build home company
businesses.write_up: Hamilton Group, formerly Scott Hamilton Custom Homes, is a design-build custom home company on East Loop 281 in Longview. The family's building legacy dates to the 1970s, when first-generation builder Frank Hamilton started a Longview home building company; his son Scott formed Hamilton Group in the 1990s, and third-generation builders Marshal and Mindy joined in the early 2010s. The team has built more than 750 custom homes, remodeled over 200 homes, and completed over 75 commercial projects across East Texas. Hamilton Group is a BBB-accredited member of the Better Business Bureau of East Texas and has received the BBB Gold Star award for 20 consecutive complaint-free years.

businesses.name: Heavens Above Aerial Imaging LLC
businesses.tagline: Longview drone photo and video for listings and land
businesses.write_up: Heavens Above Aerial Imaging, operating as Texas Photo Drones, is a Longview aerial imaging company founded and owned by Jim Quinn. The company captures aerial photos and video using FAA-registered aircraft flown by FAA-licensed commercial drone operators. Its portfolio includes residential listings, an event center, a tree farm, a cattle ranch, and tower maintenance work, with clients including Realtors, construction companies, agricultural operators, and first responders.

businesses.name: Higgs Moving Service
businesses.tagline: Family-owned East Texas movers since 2003
businesses.write_up: Higgs Moving Service is a family-owned and operated moving company based at 320 E Methvin St in downtown Longview, serving Longview, Tyler, Marshall, and the surrounding East Texas area since 2003. Services cover residential and commercial moves, truck and pod loading and unloading, packing, senior moves, office relocations, apartment moves, and in-home furniture rearranging, with piano and gun safe moves available for an added fee. The company holds an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.

businesses.name: HK Inspections
businesses.tagline: Thorough Longview home inspections with reports in 24 hours
businesses.write_up: HK Inspections is a home inspection company based in Longview, owned and operated by lead inspector Jeff Kresta. The company performs buyer, seller, and new-home inspections along with infrared moisture scans, radon testing, and pool, spa, and sprinkler inspections. Detailed electronic reports covering more than 400 items are delivered within 24 hours, and clients are encouraged to attend and walk the property with the inspector. Inspections are offered Monday through Saturday across Longview, Kilgore, White Oak, Hallsville, Gladewater, and nearby communities.

businesses.name: Homes by Noble
businesses.tagline: Custom home builds, additions, and remodels in Longview
businesses.write_up: Homes by Noble is a family-owned custom home builder based on West Loop 281 in Longview, handling custom home builds, home additions, design, and remodels in collaboration with architects and designers. The company serves Longview, Kilgore, Tyler, Henderson, and surrounding East Texas communities, with a separate commercial construction arm operating as Build with Noble. Its stated mission, the BIG approach, is to build with integrity and precision, invest in the community, and grow through craftsmanship. Homes by Noble is a member of the East Texas Builders Association and the Longview Chamber of Commerce.

businesses.name: Hopkins Custom Roofing
businesses.tagline: Veteran-owned roofing serving East Texas
businesses.write_up: Jon Hopkins, a U.S. Air Force veteran and LeTourneau University graduate, started Hopkins Custom Roofing in Longview in 2020 after moving into the roofing and construction industry in 2017. The company performs free roof inspections, repairs, and full replacements for homes and businesses across East Texas, including commercial flat-roof systems like TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen, and Jon personally performs each roof inspection. The team also guides homeowners through the insurance claims process after storms and carries $2 million in general liability roofers insurance. A second branch serves the Dallas-Fort Worth area, while the Longview office covers Kilgore, Marshall, Gilmer, Hallsville, Tyler, and surrounding communities.

businesses.name: JD's AC
businesses.tagline: Family-run heating and AC repair in Longview for 30+ years
businesses.write_up: JD's AC is a family-run HVAC company on Avenue B in Longview that has served East Texas for more than 30 years. The team handles heating and AC repair, full system installation, ductless mini-splits, duct cleaning, attic insulation, thermostats, and indoor air quality, with 24/7 emergency service and commercial HVAC work as well. JD's is a licensed Carrier dealer with NATE-certified technicians, and its Comfort Club maintenance plan covers bi-annual preventative checkups. The service area runs from Longview to Marshall, Kilgore, Gilmer, Henderson, Mt. Pleasant, and dozens of surrounding towns.

businesses.name: JennRand Diversified, LLC
businesses.tagline: Custom homes, remodels and commercial construction in East Texas
businesses.write_up: JennRand Diversified builds custom homes and handles remodeling and commercial construction throughout the Longview area. The firm lists new-construction homes for sale in Longview and is SBA and HUB certified for government and commercial work. It is a member of the East Texas Builders Association, NAHB and the Texas Association of Builders.

businesses.name: Jett Appraisal Services
businesses.tagline: Longview real estate appraisals on Dawn Circle
businesses.write_up: Jett Appraisal Services is a real estate appraisal company located on Dawn Circle in Longview. The firm provides residential appraisal services in Longview and the surrounding Gregg County area. It is a member of the Longview Area Association of REALTORS and maintains an active local presence.

businesses.name: John's Landscape & Lawn Services LLC
businesses.tagline: Landscaping, lawn maintenance, and garden care in Longview
businesses.write_up: John's Landscape & Lawn Services LLC is a Longview landscaping company located at 303 W Loop 281. The crew offers year-round or one-time lawn maintenance, planting of shrubs and flowers, garden cleanup, and landscape design. The company is open weekdays from 6 AM to 6 PM, and longtime customers describe the service as reliable and consistent. It is a practical option for homeowners who want steady upkeep or a refresh before listing a house.

businesses.name: Johnson & Pace Incorporated
businesses.tagline: Longview engineering firm with in-house licensed surveyors
businesses.write_up: Johnson & Pace Incorporated was founded in 1995 by civil engineer Wade Johnson and land surveyor Lonnie Pace, combining engineering and surveying under one roof. Headquartered at 1201 W Loop 281, Suite 100, in Longview with a second office in Bossier City, Louisiana, the firm today offers civil, structural, MEP, mining, and industrial engineering plus architecture and land surveying, serving clients across the U.S. Its land surveying department includes licensed surveyors (RPLS), CAD technicians, and multiple field crews handling boundary, topographic, and construction survey work. The firm is now led by president Delcine Johnson, and its staff includes professional engineers, registered architects, certified floodplain managers, and LEED-accredited professionals.

businesses.name: Julie Woods & Associates Real Estate Firm
businesses.tagline: Independent Longview firm led by broker Julie Woods
businesses.write_up: Julie Woods & Associates is a boutique, independently owned Longview real estate firm led by broker/owner Julie Brogoitti Woods, a lifelong East Texan with a finance degree from Stephen F. Austin State University. Julie entered real estate in 2007 through her family's Brogoitti Construction business before founding her own firm, which now operates offices at 1116 Judson Rd in Longview and 402 N Henderson Blvd in Kilgore. The firm serves buyers and sellers across Longview, Kilgore, Marshall, Gilmer, Hallsville, and the wider East Texas market, handling everything from residential homes to large ranches and commercial land. Julie is active in the community, including board service with the Longview Economic Development Corporation and United Way of Longview.

businesses.name: K's Commercial & Residential Cleaning, LLC
businesses.tagline: Church, commercial, and make-ready cleaning across East Texas
businesses.write_up: K's Commercial & Residential Cleaning is a family-run, licensed, bonded, and insured cleaning company based in Hallsville that serves Longview, Tyler, and more than 30 cities across East Texas, the Shreveport, Louisiana area, and Central Arkansas. Founded in 2017 by Kayla McBride, the company staffs background-checked W-2 employees rather than subcontractors. Church cleaning is its specialty, alongside recurring commercial and office cleaning, deep commercial kitchen cleaning, VCT floor stripping and waxing, commercial window cleaning, post-construction cleanup, and per-unit apartment turnovers. After acquiring Carpet Dr. Rx, the company also brought carpet-care capabilities in-house.

businesses.name: Kroscher & Kroscher, P.C.
businesses.tagline: Longview firm handling estate planning, probate, and guardianship
businesses.write_up: Kroscher & Kroscher, P.C. is a Longview law firm at 1126 Judson Road, opened by Charles and Jessica Kroscher in November 2009. The firm handles estate planning and probate work including wills, trusts, general and medical powers of attorney, advance directives, guardianships, and contested probate. Other listed practice areas include family law, contract disputes, business formation, and personal injury.

businesses.name: Langford Roofing
businesses.tagline: Longview roofing repair, replacement, and inspections
businesses.write_up: Langford Roofing is a Longview-based roofing contractor working out of 1727 Clearwood Dr, handling roof repair, roof replacement, metal roofing, and roof inspections for homes in Gregg County. The company also handles hail and storm damage repair and offers emergency roofing service. Service areas listed include Longview, Kilgore, Gladewater, White Oak, Gilmer, Pittsburg, Liberty City, and Winnsboro, with hours Monday through Saturday, 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

businesses.name: Law Office of J. Scott Novy
businesses.tagline: Longview attorney handling real estate, probate and estate planning matters
businesses.write_up: J. Scott Novy is a Longview attorney whose practice includes real estate, estate planning and probate, and criminal law. He was raised in Longview, attended Baylor University, and previously served as an assistant district attorney. His office is on E. Magrill Street in downtown Longview.

businesses.name: Laxton Electric
businesses.tagline: Electrical contractor on McCann Road in Longview
businesses.write_up: Laxton Electric is a licensed Texas electrical contractor (TECL #32595) with its shop on McCann Road in Longview and a mailing address in Harleton. The company serves residential, commercial, industrial, and oil field customers across Longview, Marshall, Gilmer, Mt. Pleasant, Kilgore, Henderson, Carthage, and surrounding East Texas towns. Services range from generator systems, network and data cabling, and lighting installations to service upgrades, underground trenching and boring, remodel wiring, and oil field work such as motor control centers and instrumentation. The shop is open weekdays 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with a 24-hour emergency line at (903) 720-7238.

businesses.name: Ledbetter Plumbing LLC
businesses.tagline: Second-generation family plumbing company in Longview
businesses.write_up: Ledbetter Plumbing began in 1986 as a one-man, one-truck operation run from a spare bedroom, and has grown into a five-truck company now in its second generation of family ownership under Christopher and Emily Ledbetter. Based at 1526 W Marshall Ave in Longview, the company offers commercial and residential plumbing, standard and tankless water heaters, video inspections, water softener and filtration work, and water and sewer line service. It has been BBB accredited since 1994 and holds an A+ rating, operating under state plumbing license 44613.

businesses.name: LLS Real Estate Photography & Drone
businesses.tagline: Longview real estate photography, video and drone coverage
businesses.write_up: LLS Real Estate Photography & Drone, operated by Luis Lopez, produces photo and video content for residential, commercial, and business listings in the Longview area, including aerial drone photography and video. The business works with agents, brokers, and business owners who need listing-ready imagery, and operates from 1605 Judson Rd, Suite B-2, in Longview. Booking and portfolio updates are handled through the company's Facebook page.

businesses.name: Lone Star Foundation Repair
businesses.tagline: Locally owned foundation and house leveling specialists
businesses.write_up: Lone Star Foundation Repair is a locally owned East Texas company that has helped Longview homeowners and business owners with foundation repair since 2016. Services include slab repair, pier and beam repair, house leveling, crawl space encapsulation, vapor and moisture barrier installation, and commercial foundation repair. Inspectors perform free in-person foundation evaluations, and the company obtains the building and engineering permits needed for repairs. Lone Star serves Longview, Tyler, and surrounding East Texas communities and is BBB accredited.

businesses.name: Longview Aerial Evolution
businesses.tagline: Aerial listing photos and property overviews
businesses.write_up: Longview Aerial Evolution, operating under Bouquet Boutique LLC, provides aerial photography and video from an address on Montreal Drive in Longview. Real estate work focuses on showing property layout, surroundings, and access points for listings. The company also documents construction progress and job sites and performs roof, structure, and solar panel inspections, with all flights by an FAA Part 107 certified pilot.

businesses.name: Longview Foundation Repair
businesses.tagline: Family-operated foundation repair in Longview
businesses.write_up: Longview Foundation Repair is a family-owned and operated company serving Longview and nearby communities including Gladewater, White Oak, Hallsville, Warren City, and Clarksville City. Services range from slab and pier-and-beam repair to house leveling, helical and steel push pier installation, polyurethane foam injection, retaining wall repair, and commercial foundation work. The company is BBB accredited, fully insured and bonded, and offers free estimates, lifetime transferable warranties, financing options, and military discounts. Crews are available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

businesses.name: Longview Home Inspections LLC
businesses.tagline: Locally owned inspections by a Longview native, TREC #23169
businesses.write_up: Longview Home Inspections is owned and operated by Jimmy Su, a Longview native and TREC-licensed professional inspector (#23169). The company performs residential and commercial inspections and carries $2,000,000 in general liability insurance. Su is certified through American Home Inspector Training (AHIT), holds a BA from the University of North Texas, and is also an active real estate investor and property manager, giving him a working knowledge of what buyers and landlords look for. The company is an affiliate member of the Longview Area Association of Realtors.

businesses.name: Longview Roofing LLC
businesses.tagline: Family-owned commercial and residential roofing
businesses.write_up: Longview Roofing LLC is a family-owned roofing contractor based at 505 E Cotton St in downtown Longview. The team handles commercial, residential, and industrial roofing along with custom sheet metal fabrication, gutters, and minor carpentry, with more than 50 years of roofing experience behind the operation. The company notes it is one of the few area roofing contractors that carries workers compensation coverage, and it offers free roof inspections. Past projects range from area homes to school and commercial TPO installations.

businesses.name: Lori Ivey - State Farm Insurance Agency
businesses.tagline: North Fourth Street agency writing home, auto and renters coverage
businesses.write_up: Lori Ivey has operated a State Farm agency in Longview since 2020, writing homeowners, renters, auto, life and small business coverage for Gregg, Upshur, Harrison, Rusk and Smith counties. The office is on North Fourth Street and is open weekdays. Ivey is a LeTourneau University alumna and served as 2025 chair of the Longview Chamber of Commerce board.

businesses.name: M6 Drone & Media, LLC
businesses.tagline: FAA-certified aerial photography and video across East Texas
businesses.write_up: M6 Drone & Media, LLC is a Longview-based drone photography and videography company established in 2017. The team flies a fleet of 4K-capable drones for real estate photography, aerial video, and inspection work across East Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Louisiana. M6 is licensed and insured, holds an FAA 107.29 daylight waiver for night operations, and has secured dozens of controlled-airspace authorizations for flying where many operators cannot.

businesses.name: Mantelpiece Media
businesses.tagline: Listing photography, drone and virtual staging for East Texas
businesses.write_up: Mantelpiece Media is an East Texas real estate media company serving Longview and Tyler with listing photography, video, aerial drone imagery, 3D virtual tours, twilight exteriors and virtual staging. Photos are delivered the next business day and each order includes a property website. Mike Muench is the founder and photographer.

businesses.name: Merilla Electric, LLC
businesses.tagline: Family-owned electrician for homes and businesses
businesses.write_up: Merilla Electric is a family-owned electrical contractor in Longview serving residential and commercial customers across the Greater East Texas area. Work includes lighting, generators and panel upgrades. The company is licensed and insured under Texas electrical contractor license TECL #37256.

businesses.name: Merry Maids of Longview
businesses.tagline: Locally owned cleaning team for Longview homes and businesses
businesses.write_up: Merry Maids of Longview is a locally owned franchise team providing home and business cleaning across the Longview area. Services include routine weekly, biweekly, or monthly cleanings as well as move-in, move-out, and special-occasion cleans, using environmentally friendly, pet-safe products. The team is a member of the Longview Chamber of Commerce and supports local organizations including CASA, the Alzheimer's Alliance, and Cleaning for a Reason.

businesses.name: Miller Homes Group - Longview
businesses.tagline: East Texas real estate with a Longview office on Courthouse Drive
businesses.write_up: Miller Homes Group is a Texas real estate brokerage with a Longview office at 2107 Courthouse Drive. The firm serves buyers and sellers across East Texas, with agents covering Longview, Tyler, and the surrounding communities. Its Longview team maintains a dedicated local presence alongside the firm's other East Texas locations, helping clients with residential sales, purchases, and relocations.

businesses.name: MTK Inspection Services
businesses.tagline: TREC-licensed professional inspector, TREC #10451
businesses.write_up: MTK Inspection Services is owned by Mark Keeler, a TREC-licensed professional inspector (#10451), InterNACHI Certified Professional Inspector, and Certified Master Inspector who has been a full-time licensed inspector since 2009 with a building and home improvement background of more than 25 years. Based on Rosedown Street in Longview, MTK serves Longview, Marshall, Hallsville, Kilgore, White Oak, Gladewater, Tatum, Henderson, and Gilmer. Services include full home inspections covering structural, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and appliance systems, plus termite/WDI and septic inspections, with sprinkler system checks included at no charge. Every home inspection comes with a HomeBinder digital home management account.

businesses.name: Neat Freaks
businesses.tagline: Make-ready and commercial cleaning based in Longview
businesses.write_up: Neat Freaks is a locally owned, insured and bonded cleaning company based in Longview that has served East Texas since 2014. The company specializes in make-ready cleaning for property managers and builders, along with commercial cleaning for offices, retail, and industrial facilities, event cleaning, and post-construction cleanup. Crews handle deep cleaning of floors, windows, kitchens, bathrooms, and fixtures to get properties move-in ready between tenants. Service covers Longview, Tyler, Kilgore, and Marshall, and references are available on request.

businesses.name: Newland Properties
businesses.tagline: Custom homes, townhomes, and subdivisions built in Longview
businesses.write_up: Newland Properties is a Longview home builder located on FM 2879, building custom homes, townhomes, and subdivisions in the Longview area. The company grew out of hands-on work with timber and concrete and now manages the full home building process, from raw resources to finished home. The team focuses on keeping builds on budget and on schedule while delivering modern features and finishes.

businesses.name: Noble Roofing
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial roofing with a Longview office
businesses.write_up: Noble Roofing is a family-owned roofing company that began in East Texas serving Kilgore, Henderson, Longview, and Tyler, and has since expanded with a West Texas branch covering Lubbock and Amarillo. Its Longview office at 4902 W Loop 281 handles residential and commercial roof installation, replacement, repair, metal roofing, and roof coatings, with free inspections and financing options available. Inspectors hold Texas insurance adjuster licenses, which helps when documenting hail and wind damage for insurance claims, though the company does not offer legal advice on claims. Noble is BBB accredited with an A rating and backs its work with both manufacturer and workmanship warranties.

businesses.name: North State Appraisal, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial real estate appraisals in the Longview area
businesses.write_up: North State Appraisal, Inc. is a licensed appraisal firm that lists Longview, TX as its market area, producing residential and commercial real estate appraisals and property value opinions used by banks and lending institutions. Appraiser Chris Talley is named on the firm's site, which handles estate, divorce, expert witness, and assessment appeal valuation work. Commercial valuations cover industrial parks and warehouses, office buildings, restaurants, multi-family apartment buildings, fitness centers, and convention facilities.

businesses.name: Olshan Foundation Solutions - Longview
businesses.tagline: National foundation repair company with a Longview branch
businesses.write_up: Olshan Foundation Solutions runs a Longview branch at 2916 Gum Springs Road serving Gregg County and surrounding East Texas. Services listed include foundation repair and house leveling, crawl space repair, under-slab plumbing, root barriers, and exterior water management and drainage, with slab repairs using the company Cable Lock ST Plus piling system. The company states it has been in business since 1933 and that structural assessments are performed by its certified technicians.

businesses.name: Palmer Inspections
businesses.tagline: Family-owned Longview inspection company, TREC #26108
businesses.write_up: Palmer Inspections is a family-owned home inspection company founded by Kyle Palmer, TREC licensed (#26108) and InterNACHI Certified Professional Inspector, serving Longview, Tyler, and surrounding East Texas communities including Kilgore, Hallsville, White Oak, and Gladewater. Services include residential and pre-listing inspections, sewer scopes, septic, pool and spa, mobile and manufactured home, and wood-destroying insect inspections. The team holds advanced certifications in areas such as infrared, drone, plumbing, electrical, and WDO inspection. Each inspection concludes with a detailed report featuring high-quality photos and clear explanations, and clients can schedule online 24/7.

businesses.name: Patriot Pride Inspections, PLLC
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial inspections across Northeast Texas
businesses.write_up: Patriot Pride Inspections is a Longview home inspection company owned by Bobby Burch, located on Pine Tree Rd. The company performs residential home inspections, pre-listing inspections, new construction inspections, and commercial inspections. Its stated service area covers Northeast Texas including Longview, Tyler, Henderson, Marshall, Jefferson, Gilmer, Jacksonville, Canton, and Quitman.

businesses.name: Peachee Keen Interiors
businesses.tagline: Home staging and interior styling in Longview
businesses.write_up: Peachee Keen Interiors is a Longview home staging and interior styling business led by owner Ashley Fenton, who holds a B.S. in Interior Merchandising and Interior Design from Stephen F. Austin State University. Services include staging for real estate listings, interior and event styling, and interior, luxury, and renovation design boards that help buyers and homeowners visualize a space. Ashley works with agents and sellers in the Longview area to get listings market-ready and photographed at their best.

businesses.name: Pither Plumbing Co. Inc.
businesses.tagline: Family-owned Longview plumbing experts since 1952
businesses.write_up: Pither Plumbing has been family-owned and serving Longview since 1952, making it one of the most established plumbing companies in East Texas. From its office at 310 W Methvin St, the company handles residential and commercial plumbing, emergency service, pump repair, video camera inspections, and modern trenchless pipe repair that spares lawns and floors from digging. The company operates under master plumber license M-11425 held by Patrick L. Pither. Its hydroexcavation and trenchless capabilities let it take on jobs many smaller shops cannot.

businesses.name: Premiere Management
businesses.tagline: Longview-area rental homes and duplexes
businesses.write_up: Premiere Management manages single-family rental homes, duplexes and manufactured homes in Longview and White Oak, with current availability posted on its site. Listings span the Pine Tree, Spring Hill and White Oak school districts. The office handles leasing and day-to-day management for owners.

businesses.name: Prestigious Custom Homes
businesses.tagline: Longview custom home builder and general contractor
businesses.write_up: Prestigious Custom Homes was established in 2010 and serves the greater Longview area as a full-service general contractor. Owners Tommy and Casey Daniel build new custom homes, offer spec homes for purchase, and take on light commercial work, coordinating architectural drawings, engineering, interior design, 3D renderings, and project management. The company states a one-year minimum workmanship warranty on its builds.

businesses.name: Professional Appraisers of Texas, Inc.
businesses.tagline: Residential appraisal firm serving Longview and beyond
businesses.write_up: Professional Appraisers of Texas, Inc. is a residential appraisal firm with its office on Gilmer Road in Longview and a mailing address in Judson, providing appraisals throughout the Longview, Tyler, DFW, and Houston metro areas. The team handles mortgage appraisals, divorce and probate/estate appraisals, property tax protest appraisals, PMI removal appraisals, and pre-listing appraisals. The firm also offers third-party inspections with floor plan drawings and works with lenders, realtors, attorneys, owners, and buyers. A full office staff supports scheduling and report delivery.

businesses.name: Pyramid Homes
businesses.tagline: New-home builder serving Longview, Tyler and Flint
businesses.write_up: Pyramid Homes builds new single-family homes in Longview and across East Texas, with completed inventory homes and customizable floor plans. The company markets energy-efficient construction and lists active homes for sale in Longview neighborhoods. Anwar Khalifa is president of the company.

businesses.name: Ramsey Realty Group
businesses.tagline: Longview brokerage led by broker/owner Jeff Ramsey
businesses.write_up: Ramsey Realty Group is a Longview real estate brokerage led by broker/owner Jeff Ramsey with broker associate and co-owner Mindy Scott. The firm serves buyers and sellers across Longview, Hallsville, White Oak, Spring Hill, Pine Tree, Kilgore, and the wider East Texas area from its main office at 1405 Lago Tr, and Spanish-speaking service is available. Its stated mission emphasizes service, agent education and training, and community support, and the team handles residential, land, and investment transactions. The office can be reached at 903.759.3333.

businesses.name: RE/MAX First Choice
businesses.tagline: RE/MAX franchise serving Longview
businesses.write_up: RE/MAX First Choice is the RE/MAX franchise brokerage serving Longview, with offices on West Loop 281 and Judson Road. Its agents handle residential and commercial transactions throughout Gregg County under the international RE/MAX brand.

businesses.name: Reliable Lawn and Landscape, LLC
businesses.tagline: Full-service lawn care and landscaping in Longview
businesses.write_up: Reliable Lawn & Landscape provides residential and commercial lawn care and landscaping in Longview and nearby Gladewater and Gilmer. Crews handle mowing and maintenance, decorative edging, retaining walls, mulch and rock installation, and drainage solutions such as grading, drains, and drip zone installations. The company also installs and repairs sprinkler systems and builds fences for homes and businesses, and it operates its own plant nursery. Work ranges from small country backyards to large commercial properties, with quotes available by phone or online.

businesses.name: Reliable Management
businesses.tagline: Longview leasing and property management for homes, duplexes and apartments
businesses.write_up: Reliable Management leases residential homes, apartments, duplexes, townhomes, condos, and storage units across Longview and East Texas, and offers full property management services for owners. Its lease inventory covers Longview plus Gilmer, Tatum, Hallsville, Marshall, Tyler, Gladewater, White Oak, Kilgore, Henderson, Big Sandy, and surrounding communities, with listings updated daily. The office is on N. Green Street in Longview, and the company also lists homes for sale through its sister brand, Reliable Real Estate. The firm operates under Texas Real Estate Commission brokerage rules and displays Fair Housing compliance.

businesses.name: Richard Holt Plumbing Inc.
businesses.tagline: Longview plumbing, drains, and water heaters since 1999
businesses.write_up: Richard Holt Plumbing has been a go-to plumbing team in Longview since 1999, handling repairs, drain cleaning, sewer lines, gas lines, and water heaters for homes and businesses across East Texas. The company operates from Johnson Road in Longview under Master Plumber License M-10683, with licensed, professionally trained plumbers on staff. Senior citizen, veteran, and first responder discounts are available, and online payment is accepted.

businesses.name: Richard Parker Plumbing, LLC
businesses.tagline: Longview plumbing shop since 1974
businesses.write_up: Richard Parker Plumbing provides residential and new-construction plumbing in Longview, including drain and sewer service, camera pipe inspection, and repair of pipes, fittings and fixtures. The business was established in 1974 and operates weekdays from its West Marshall Avenue location.

businesses.name: Roto-Rooter Plumbing (Longview)
businesses.tagline: 24/7 plumbing and drain service, Longview branch
businesses.write_up: Roto-Rooter's Longview location on W Loop 281 provides drain cleaning, emergency plumbing, water heater work, pipe repair, and camera line inspections for homes and businesses, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The branch is operated as an independent contractor under the national Roto-Rooter brand, which dates to 1935, and is managed locally by Michael Lee. It does not charge extra for nights, weekends, or holidays, and technicians address the slab leaks, tree root intrusion, and hard-water issues common in Longview's clay-soil terrain. Licensed plumber on record: Brent T. Minaker, RMP-43897.

businesses.name: Royal Plumbing
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial plumbing in Longview since 2000
businesses.write_up: Royal Plumbing has served Longview and surrounding East Texas areas since 2000 from its shop on W Loop 281. Services include clogged drain repair, leak and toilet repairs, water heater replacement, slab leak detection, sewer line repairs, gas leak detection and gas line work, plus plumbing for remodels and new construction. The company emphasizes free estimates and long-term customer relationships, and is licensed through the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners (Danny King, RMP-29939).

businesses.name: Rustic Roots Property Management
businesses.tagline: Residential and commercial property management in Longview and East Texas
businesses.write_up: Rustic Roots Property Management provides residential and commercial property management in Longview and across East Texas, including Tyler, Kilgore, Marshall, Gilmer, and Henderson. Services include tenant screening and placement, lease administration and renewals, rent collection and financial reporting, maintenance coordination, marketing of vacant properties, property inspections, and eviction management, plus vacation rental and HOA management. The company is licensed and insured, uses the TurboTenant platform for renters, and keeps weekday office hours.

businesses.name: Satterwhite Log Homes
businesses.tagline: Log home producer headquartered in Longview since 1974
businesses.write_up: Satterwhite Log Homes has been headquartered in Longview since 1974, with offices, warehouses, and manufacturing facilities on US Highway 259. The company harvests standing dead timber and manufactures it into house logs, and has built homes for more than 30,000 families, from small cabins to large log lodges. The Longview location keeps two model homes open for tours, with a log home subdivision nearby, and the company also operates offices in Ellijay, Georgia and Gunnison, Utah. Satterwhite's Longview location is BBB accredited with an A+ rating, and customizable floor plans let buyers adapt designs to their needs.

businesses.name: Secure Storage Systems
businesses.tagline: Locally owned North Longview self storage since 1999
businesses.write_up: Secure Storage Systems has been locally owned in North Longview since 1999, located at 6376 U.S. Hwy 259 near Johnston-McQueen Elementary and Forest Lake. The facility offers climate-controlled and drive-up storage units, all on the ground floor, with month-to-month contracts, gate access, surveillance cameras, and online bill pay. Trucks and trailers are available for rent, along with moving boxes and supplies on the premises. Its spot just off US-259 makes it an easy stop for households in Longview, Judson, and Diana.

businesses.name: Shelton Homes
businesses.tagline: Building excellence in Longview and East Texas since 2017
businesses.write_up: Shelton Homes is a custom home builder and general contractor based in Longview, established in January 2017. The company designs and builds custom homes and also takes on remodels, disaster repair and insurance work, and commercial projects across Longview and the surrounding East Texas area. The team emphasizes hands-on project management and a design process that blends each client's vision with functional, well-crafted construction.

businesses.name: Southern Survey Company
businesses.tagline: Longview land surveying and site consulting
businesses.write_up: Southern Survey Company (Southern Survey and Design) is a Longview land surveying and site consulting business formed in 2009 to serve East Texas. Its work includes title surveying for realty transactions, topographic design and construction layout, feasibility surveys, technical inspections, consulting and mapping, and oil and gas development surveying; the team's field experience covers more than 40 regional airports, 300+ gas well sites, and miles of pipeline work. The company is an active member of the Texas Society of Professional Surveyors, the Longview Chamber of Commerce, and the East Texas Builders Association. The office is at 171 FM 1844 in Longview.

businesses.name: Spring Hill Self Storage
businesses.tagline: Family-owned storage on Gilmer Road since 1979
businesses.write_up: Spring Hill Self Storage is a family-owned storage facility at 4801 Gilmer Rd in Longview, in operation since 1979. It offers personal and business storage units in a range of sizes, all ground-level with roll-up doors and available month to month, plus covered and uncovered RV, boat, and vehicle parking. On-site amenities include an RV dump station and propane, with gate access from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

businesses.name: Spring Hill State Bank
businesses.tagline: Independent Longview bank offering mortgage services
businesses.write_up: Spring Hill State Bank is an independent, locally owned community bank established in 1977, with its main bank on Gilmer Road and a second Longview location on Hollybrook Drive. The bank offers consumer, commercial, and real estate lending, including 30-year home mortgage loans, alongside personal and business checking, savings, online banking, and mobile deposit. It has offered Saturday banking since 1978 and invests the large majority of its loans within the local area. Member FDIC and Equal Housing Lender.

businesses.name: Summers Cook & COmpany
businesses.tagline: Longview real estate company on Judson Road
businesses.write_up: Summers Cook & COmpany is a Longview real estate firm located at 1127 Judson Rd, Suite 146, handling residential listings and buyer representation across Longview, Gregg County, and surrounding East Texas communities including Hallsville, Kilgore, White Oak, Gilmer, and the area lakes. The firm's agents work listings from Pine Tree and Spring Hill to Lake Cherokee waterfront property, and the company also markets the Cherokee Shores development. Summers Cook has been voted a Locals Love Us favorite in the Longview area.

businesses.name: Sung R. Kim, Attorney at Law
businesses.tagline: Probate, heirship, and property deed work in Longview
businesses.write_up: Sung R. Kim is a Longview attorney with an office at 505 Magrill St. handling probate and property transfer matters. Listed probate services include probate of a will as muniment of title, letters testamentary, determination of heirship, small estate affidavits, and affidavits of heirship. Property transfer work includes executor deeds, Lady Bird deeds, transfer on death deeds, and general deeds, alongside estate planning documents and trusts.

businesses.name: Supreme Lending - Longview Branch
businesses.tagline: Judson Road mortgage branch led by Rodney Malone
businesses.write_up: Supreme Lending (Everett Financial, Inc. dba Supreme Lending, NMLS #2129) operates a Longview branch on Judson Road managed by Rodney Malone, NMLS #132831. The branch offers conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, renovation and construction financing among other programs. Supreme Lending is an Equal Housing Opportunity lender; all products are subject to credit and property approval.

businesses.name: T D P Electric
businesses.tagline: Licensed residential and commercial electricians in Longview
businesses.write_up: T D P Electric is a licensed and insured electrical contractor based on Regency Drive in Longview, serving homes and businesses within about a 30-mile radius including Henderson and Kilgore. Owner Thomas Pruitt started the business in 2012, according to its BBB profile, and the company is BBB accredited. The team handles electrical troubleshooting, circuit breaker replacement, panel repairs and upgrades, new construction wiring, remodel work, and code-compliant corrections.

businesses.name: Tarry Title
businesses.tagline: Tradition redefined - title and escrow with a Longview office
businesses.write_up: Tarry Title, Inc. is a Texas title insurance and escrow company with a Longview office at 4496 US Highway 259 North.
