The company pairs traditional closings with an electronic platform that lets buyers, sellers, and agents track a transaction's status from contract to closing. In addition to Longview, Tarry Title operates offices in Tyler, Mineola, Athens, and Lindale, serving real estate transactions across East Texas. The Longview location is a member of the Longview Chamber of Commerce.

businesses.name: Texas Bank and Trust - TBT Mortgage
businesses.tagline: Longview-based community bank with a dedicated mortgage office
businesses.write_up: Texas Bank and Trust is an independent financial institution established in 1958 and headquartered in Longview. Its dedicated TBT Mortgage office on Gilmer Road handles home lending for East Texas and the DFW area, with branch services covering new construction, home improvement, first-time homebuyer, and refinancing programs staffed by Texas-licensed professionals. Mortgage lending sits alongside the bank's personal, business, and wealth management services. FDIC-insured and an Equal Housing Lender; all loans are subject to credit approval.

businesses.name: Texas Real Estate Executives - Longview
businesses.tagline: Longview brokerage on McCann Road
businesses.write_up: Texas Real Estate Executives is a Longview real estate brokerage established in 2017, with its office at 1409 McCann Rd. The firm's agents provide residential buying and selling services in Longview and the surrounding East Texas market, with listings spanning Gregg County and nearby communities. The brokerage also operates a Gilmer-area presence and markets itself around agent training and client service.

businesses.name: The Grounds Guys of Longview
businesses.tagline: Locally owned landscaping and lawn care serving Longview
businesses.write_up: The Grounds Guys of Longview is a locally owned landscaping franchise, part of the Neighborly family of home service brands, based in Hallsville and serving the Longview area. The team handles residential and commercial work including custom landscape design, planting, sod and seed installation, irrigation services, and tree and shrub care. Regular lawn maintenance programs help homeowners keep curb appeal up year-round, which matters whether you are settling in or getting ready to sell.

businesses.name: Thieman & Associates, Inc.
businesses.tagline: East Texas appraisal firm serving Longview for decades
businesses.write_up: Thieman & Associates, Inc. is a real estate appraisal firm with an office on Judson Road in Longview and a presence in Kilgore. The firm has served East Texas for decades, providing residential appraisals and valuation services for lenders, homeowners, and real estate professionals across Gregg County. Clients note timely turnarounds on lender appraisals.

businesses.name: Tidy Tribe Cleaning Co.
businesses.tagline: Residential cleaning and deep cleans around Longview
businesses.write_up: Tidy Tribe Cleaning Co. is a residential cleaning company serving Longview and nearby communities. The company handles routine cleaning tasks through deep cleaning and builds a customized cleaning plan for each home. Its listed service area covers Longview, New Diana, Hallsville, White Oak, Gladewater, Gilmer, and Kilgore.

businesses.name: Timothy G. Moore, Attorney at Law
businesses.tagline: Longview attorney focused on real estate and business law
businesses.write_up: Timothy G. Moore is a Longview attorney who practices real estate and business law. He earned his law degree from Texas Tech University School of Law and has practiced for more than three decades. His office is on Pine Tree Road in Longview.

businesses.name: TLC Lawn & Landscape, LLC
businesses.tagline: Locally owned lawn and landscape company
businesses.write_up: TLC Lawn & Landscape is a Christian, family-centered, locally owned company serving Longview and surrounding areas with residential, commercial, and HOA lawn care and landscaping, and it also takes on work in Louisiana and Arkansas. Owner-operator David Thomas has lived in Longview since 1988 and has run a lawn and landscaping business since 2001. The company is licensed, bonded, and insured; employees undergo background checks and drug testing, and each contracted property is assigned a personal property manager with a team of auditors to maintain quality. Commercial janitorial and office cleaning services round out the offering.

businesses.address: 2393 H G Mosley Pkwy, Bldg 1, Ste 100
businesses.name: Truly Title - Longview
businesses.tagline: Title and escrow office on H G Mosley Parkway
businesses.write_up: Truly Title operates a Longview office at 2393 H G Mosley Pkwy, Building 1, Suite 100, staffed by title and escrow professionals experienced in local real estate closing procedures. The office handles title insurance and escrow services for buyers, sellers, lenders, and agents in the Longview area as part of Truly Title's network of Texas offices. The local team can be reached at (903) 781-5396 or longviewteam@trulytitle.com.

businesses.name: Trust Foundation Repair
businesses.tagline: Slab and pier-and-beam foundation work across East Texas
businesses.write_up: Trust Foundation Repair provides slab repair, pier-and-beam work, house leveling, crawl space encapsulation, moisture barriers and polyurethane foam injection for Longview-area properties. The company has operated since 1976 and covers Longview from its East Texas base. Free foundation inspections and quotes are offered.

businesses.name: Turfscapes
businesses.tagline: Landscape design, installation, and maintenance since 2009
businesses.write_up: Turfscapes is a family-run landscape company founded in 2009 by Mikael Rapazzo, based in Judson just north of Longview. The team handles landscape design and installation, lawn care and maintenance, sprinkler system installation and repair, fertilization and weed control, French drains and drainage, landscape lighting, paver patios and masonry, retaining walls, and erosion control. Service areas include Longview, Kilgore, Marshall, Gladewater, White Oak, and surrounding East Texas communities. Texas licenses on file include TPCL 0750575, irrigation licenses LI0019930 and LI0027077, and backflow license BP0014659.

businesses.name: U.S. Title Company, Inc.
businesses.tagline: East Texas title insurance and escrow since 1984
businesses.write_up: U.S. Title Company opened in Longview in 1984 with a commitment to building long-term client relationships, and it continues to provide title insurance, abstracting, and escrow services for residential and commercial closings. Acting as escrow agent, the company holds legal documents and funds on behalf of buyers and sellers, handling everything from multi-million dollar and multi-state transactions to neighborhood home closings. U.S. Title operates six locations across East Texas, with its Longview office at 1111 Judson Rd serving Gregg County and the surrounding area.

businesses.name: Voss Media
businesses.tagline: Real estate photography and video that helps homes sell faster
businesses.write_up: Voss Media LLC is a Longview photography and video company founded by Bobby Voss in 2018. For real estate clients, the studio produces MLS-ready listing photos, FAA Part 107-certified drone imagery, cinematic walkthrough videos, and twilight shots designed to help East Texas listings stand out online. Bobby serves agents and brokers across East Texas with a clean, consistent visual style and online booking for listing shoots.

businesses.name: Wilco Premium Roofing
businesses.tagline: Family-owned roofing and exterior contractor on Gilmer Road
businesses.write_up: Wilco Premium Roofing is a family-owned roofing contractor in Longview handling residential and commercial roofing, storm and hail damage repair, metal roofing, gutters and siding. The company states it has served East Texas for more than 20 years and is a manufacturer-verified installer for brands including Atlas and Mule-Hide. Its service area covers Longview, White Oak, Hallsville, Gladewater, Kilgore and nearby communities.

businesses.name: Wood Engineering Co., Inc.
businesses.tagline: Longview civil engineering firm with land surveying and inspection services
businesses.write_up: Wood Engineering Co., Inc. is a full-service civil engineering firm in Longview that provides land and boundary surveying alongside commercial and residential site development, structural engineering, municipal engineering, and building inspections. The office is on Judson Road in Longview and is open weekdays.

businesses.name: Woodson Appraisal
businesses.tagline: Residential appraisals in Longview by Mark Woodson
businesses.write_up: Woodson Appraisal is a residential real estate appraisal practice in Longview operated by Mark Woodson. Mark holds ERC and HUD certifications and provides appraisals for home purchases, refinances, and other valuation needs in Gregg County and the surrounding area. The business is a member of the Longview Area Association of REALTORS.

businesses.name: Wyers Properties
businesses.tagline: Duplexes, single-family rentals, and management since 1992
businesses.write_up: Wyers Properties has served the Longview area since 1992, managing a selection of duplexes, single-family homes, and commercial properties in quiet neighborhoods, and offering property management services to owners. Residents use an AppFolio online portal for secure rent payments and routine maintenance requests, and the company keeps its rentals updated and maintained. Based on Reel Road in Longview, Wyers is affiliated with Texas Realtors, the National Association of Realtors, and the Texas Apartment Association, and operates under Texas Real Estate Commission consumer protection rules.
